verdict.line: Picture a student who needs a quick smoke‑filter during an evacuation; GripTok turns a normal phone grip into a temporary breathing aid, making it useful for safety drills. It also adds a unique design element to the phone. The catch: it has not been safety‑certified for real fire situations.
